mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, and check in with how I feel before getting up.
mara.intention: Begin the day without rushing.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, get dressed, and make the bed.
mara.intention: Get ready for an unhurried morning.

mara.activity: Make coffee and a light breakfast at the kitchen island, carrying a mug and plate to the island and reading a few pages nearby.
mara.intention: Keep the familiar slow breakfast while leaving the morning open and companionable.

mara.activity: Clear the breakfast things, rinse the mug and plate, and carry my laptop and mail from the kitchen to the office.
mara.intention: Reset the kitchen before household planning.

mara.activity: Review household bills and the week's calendar at the office desk, making notes and filing the mail.
mara.intention: Handle practical decisions before leaving for class.

mara.activity: Take a short break, make tea, and sit in the living room with my field notebook to jot down a few observations from yesterday's class.
mara.intention: Let the planning work end cleanly and keep the ceramics practice connected to my own thoughts.

mara.activity: Eat a small lunch at the kitchen island, then wash the bowl and mug and put the field notebook on the living room sideboard countertop.
mara.intention: Have enough to eat before class without making the afternoon heavy.

mara.activity: Change for ceramics, gather my tote, notebook, pencil, and water bottle, and put my keys in my pocket before leaving.
mara.intention: Prepare deliberately and arrive without rushing.

mara.activity: Walk to the ceramics studio and take the afternoon class, concentrating on the work rather than trying to make it client-ready.
mara.intention: Enjoy being a beginner, tolerate imperfect results, and maintain this separate social world.

mara.activity: Walk home slowly, put my keys deliberately in the open entryway while removing my shoes, and carry my tote and notebook inside.
mara.intention: Transition home instead of carrying the class straight into the evening.

mara.activity: Wash my hands, change into an evening sweater and lounge pants, drink water, and sit briefly in the living room.
mara.intention: Rest and notice how the class felt before beginning dinner preparation.

mara.activity: Prepare a large vegetable-and-tomato meal for leftovers, using the cast iron skillet and saucepan, then portion it into food storage bags and leave the kitchen orderly.
mara.intention: Follow the usual large-meal routine while making food that can accommodate Julian's later schedule.

mara.activity: Carry a bowl of the meal and a water glass to the living room, eat quietly, and leave the kitchen available for Julian's later cooking.
mara.intention: Make room for shared time without requiring the new schedule to behave like the old one.

mara.activity: Carry the bowl and glass back to the kitchen, rinse them, wipe the island, and place my keys on the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Close the meal gently and keep tomorrow morning easier.

mara.activity: Read in the living room and answer only necessary messages, keeping the phone beside me rather than trying to resolve the restaurant schedule tonight.
mara.intention: Protect a quiet end to the day and let the new rhythm settle gradually.

mara.activity: Take a warm shower, brush my teeth, and put the evening clothes away.
mara.intention: Wind down physically after class and cooking.

mara.activity: Play a few slow scales in the piano hall with the lights low, letting the concentration from ceramics soften into a familiar practice.
mara.intention: Settle my mind without turning the evening into another task.

mara.activity: Return to the main bedroom, read in bed, and exchange any necessary messages without trying to solve the new schedule tonight.
mara.intention: End the day with warmth and perspective.

mara.activity: Put my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand, set my phone beside them, and turn out the light.
mara.intention: Put the things I need in their dependable places before sleep.

mara.activity: Sleep in the main bedroom bed.
mara.intention: Rest for the next day.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, wash up, brush my teeth, and change out of sleep clothes. I make the bed loosely and leave the room quietly while the house is still calm.
julian.intention: Start slowly and recover from yesterday's late service without making decisions yet.

julian.activity: Collect the coffee beans and a mug in the kitchen, grind the beans, and make coffee. I take a banana from the kitchen and carry the mug and fruit to the island, bringing the restaurant notebook over only to glance at it without opening into planning.
julian.intention: Settle into a quiet breakfast routine and avoid turning the morning into work.

julian.activity: Make pancakes and eggs at the range while Mara reads nearby. I carry the eggs, butter, flour, mixing bowl, whisk, cast iron skillet, wooden spoon, plate, and water glasses to where they are needed, then sit at the island to eat with her.
julian.intention: Share an unhurried breakfast and give Mara dependable time with me before the week changes pace again.

julian.activity: Rinse the breakfast dishes, wipe the island and range, and put the mug and cookware back. I fill a water bottle, take my wallet from the living room coffee table, and take my keys from the piano's middle shelf before meeting Mara for the walk.
julian.intention: Leave the kitchen reset without over-cleaning or creating a new project.

julian.activity: Take a long walk with Mara and have lunch away from the restaurant. I carry my phone, wallet, keys, and water bottle, keeping the conversation loose rather than discussing schedules in detail.
julian.intention: Protect relaxed shared time and let my body come down from the intensity of service work.

julian.activity: Return home, put my keys back on the piano's middle shelf, and set my wallet on the living room coffee table. I drink water, rinse the bottle, and rest quietly without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Have a no-decision recovery hour after the walk and lunch.

julian.activity: Sit at the piano with my music notebook and piano music book, practicing the new melodies softly at first and then playing through the strongest one a little louder. I leave the notebook on the piano stool when I finish.
julian.intention: Keep a small creative routine that is mine, without demanding a performance from myself.

julian.activity: Rest while Mara prepares the large meal. I stay available without directing her, then bring out plates, cloth napkins, forks, and water glasses and help make space at the dining table.
julian.intention: Support Mara's cooking without taking over the meal or adding pressure.

julian.activity: Eat dinner with Mara, then help portion the leftovers into food storage bags and bowls for the week. I carry the serving dishes and utensils back to the kitchen, refrigerate the portions, and wash the few items that need attention.
julian.intention: Turn Mara's large meal into an easy beginning to the week and enjoy the shared evening before the later restaurant schedule takes more time.

julian.activity: Make a small mug of tea, carry it to the living room, and sit quietly with Mara. I do not open the restaurant notebook or start Monday ordering tonight.
julian.intention: Keep the evening restorative and preserve the feeling that home is not another shift.

julian.activity: Take a warm shower, dry off, put on sleep clothes, and leave the towel hanging in the bathroom. I rinse the mug and place my phone on its charger in the bedroom.
julian.intention: Use the familiar post-service routine to let my body know the day is over.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara, keep the lights low, and fall asleep without turning on the television. I put my sleep mask on the nightstand rather than making a late-night fuss.
julian.intention: Sleep early enough to recover before the restaurant's less predictable week.
